note: One card per repository. Every plate row is an annotation on a drawn parcel, and DESIGN.md requires every one of them to be true of the repository the card describes. Rows are copy, reviewed like copy. The only substitutions are {version}, {package}, {svgFiles}, and {pngFiles}, which the build fills from this repository.

fields.subject: The repository the card describes. Recorded in the manifest so a card cannot be reused for the wrong repository by accident.
fields.title: The card's accessible name and og:title. Not drawn.
fields.product: Optional. Drawn under the wordmark, to the product lockup's proportions. Omit for cards that speak for the org rather than a product.
fields.description: One line per array entry. Two is the practical maximum.
fields.plateRows: One annotation per drawn parcel; exactly three.
fields.footer: The mono line at the foot of the card.
